docs.title: Session Finalizer Architecture
docs.content:
Session Finalizer Architecture

The session finalizer pipeline converts idle coding-agent sessions into consolidated session documents.

## Triage stage
Sessions arrive in session_finalize_queue. The triage stage (SessionTriageAgent) batches sessions in token-budget packs of up to 150K tokens and scores them 0-10. Sessions scoring >= 7.0 advance to extraction.

## Extraction stage
The finalizer agent (SessionFinalizerAgent in services/finalizer/agent.py) processes triaged sessions and writes or updates consolidated session documents. It uses Gemini 3.1 Pro.

## Nightly schedule
The finalizer cron fires at 04:00 UTC, waking the worker via pg_notify on session_finalize_pending.
